paper_metadata.title: Performance Comparison of QAOA Mixers for Ternary Portfolio Optimization

experiments.description: QAOA portfolio optimization on a ternary asset-selection problem using the Standard Mixer, evaluated on real DAX30-derived instances at N=5, B=2 and N=8, B=4, with noiseless statevector and shot-based Qasm simulations, plus a depolarizing-noise study.

algorithm.variant: QAOA with Standard Mixer for ternary portfolio optimization
algorithm.ansatz: Standard QAOA alternating cost unitary and X-mixer
algorithm.parameter_initialization: For p=1, grid search over linear schedules gamma_k = m1 * x_k^(p), beta_k = m2 * (1 - x_k^(p)); for p>1, four estimation methods based on prior work and the one minimizing the objective was adopted.

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Each ternary asset variable z_i in {1,0,-1} is encoded with two qubits via binary variables x_i^+, x_i^- and z_i = x_i^+ - x_i^-; total 2N qubits.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize F(z) = q * sum_{i,j} sigma_ij z_i z_j - (1-q) * sum_i mu_i z_i subject to sum_i z_i = B; with penalty version F^(A)(z) = F(z) + A (sum_i z_i - B)^2 for Standard Mixer runs.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Penalty term for Standard Mixer; hard constraint preserved by XY mixers (not the Standard Mixer experiment itself).
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: F-hat obtained by substituting z_i -> (Z_i^- - Z_i^+)/2; cost unitary uses pairwise ZZ terms and single-qubit Z terms with coefficients W_ij and w_i.

problem_instance.description: Ternary portfolio optimization on DAX30-derived assets with budget constraint.

preprocessing: daily adjusted closing prices from Yahoo Finance
missing dates dropped
daily simple returns computed
annualized expected returns via geometric compounding assuming 252 trading days/year
annualized covariance matrix via 252 x sample covariance

noise_parameters.depolarizing_applied_after: every one-qubit and two-qubit gate on each target qubit

classical_preprocessing: portfolio data acquisition from Yahoo Finance
penalty coefficient selection via penalty-efficient estimation algorithm

speedup_claims.caveats: No classical runtime or speedup comparison is reported; the paper compares QAOA mixers against each other and against noise levels.

experiments.description: QAOA portfolio optimization on the same ternary DAX30-derived instances using the XY Ring Mixer, evaluated in noiseless and noisy simulations.

algorithm.variant: QAOA with XY Ring Mixer for ternary portfolio optimization
algorithm.ansatz: XY Ring mixer ansatz with Dicke-state initial state
algorithm.parameter_initialization: For p=1, grid search over linear schedules; for p>1, four estimation methods based on prior work and the one minimizing the objective was adopted.

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Two qubits per asset; feasible subspace enforced by fixed-Hamming-weight Dicke-state encoding on 2N qubits.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize ternary mean-variance cost F(z) = q sum_{i,j} sigma_ij z_i z_j - (1-q) sum_i mu_i z_i subject to sum_i z_i = B.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Hard constraint via XY mixer and feasible initial state; no penalty term used.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Cost Hamiltonian built from Z^- and Z^+ operators with pairwise ZZ terms and single-qubit Z terms.
